collection.description: A nursing mother loses her infant, and the village struggles to support her.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A nursing mother loses her infant after an illness despite the caregivers' efforts. The village struggles to know how to support her.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: She asks for privacy and practical help; friends honor both.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: She chooses whether and when to participate, and the baby's name is spoken with care.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: Trusted caregivers handle chores and meals; the mother's grief is neither hurried nor treated as a moral failing.
